case_scope: EU investor citizenship/residence and golden-passport/golden-visa stress screen

jurisdictional_mobility_gate.note: Investment-migration schemes remain a live Gate 13 watch/fail surface because CRS circumvention, weak physical-presence tests, source-of-funds risk, visa-free access, and EU citizenship mutual-trust effects must all be verified together.

residence_citizenship_by_investment_risk.note: The case cannot pass while purchased citizenship/residence can confer tax, mobility, banking, or EU/internal-market access faster than ordinary claimant pathways and before due-diligence failures are visible.

tax_residency_enforcement.note: Tax residence and CRS self-certification must be tested against actual physical presence, account due diligence, controlling-person reporting, and beneficial-owner verification.

crs_aeoi_information_exchange_coverage.note: CRS/AEOI coverage is necessary but not sufficient; CBI/RBI risk persists when residence certificates or tax residence claims are accepted without robust presence and due-diligence checks.

migrant_claimant_perimeter_exclusion.note: The ordinary migrant comparison remains part of the proof burden: investor access should be compared with work, family, refugee, and long-residence routes that create real social claims.

proof_debt: country-level CBI/RBI approvals, refusals, and revocations
property-market and political-access effects of investment routes

gate_13_jurisdictional_mobility.why: Gate 13 is blocked until investment migration has program-level due-diligence, presence, tax-residence, ordinary-migrant-comparator, and visa/infringement follow-through evidence.

gate_10_measurement_uncertainty.why: CBI/RBI risk is partly a measurement problem: residence certificates and account reporting can misclassify where wealth and control really sit.

evidence_debt_register.question: country-level CBI/RBI approvals, refusals, and revocations
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect annual scheme-level approval, denial, revocation, nationality, and due-diligence data instead of relying on the existence of nominal safeguards.

evidence_debt_register.question: source-of-funds and beneficial-owner failure rates
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track actual due-diligence findings, beneficial-owner mismatches, sanctions/PEP exposure, and intermediaries rather than accepting program rules as proof of integrity.

evidence_debt_register.question: physical-presence and tax-residence verification
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Compare legal residence/citizenship with days present, tax residency, CRS account reporting, and controlling-person reporting.

evidence_debt_register.question: property-market and political-access effects of investment routes
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure investment-route effects on housing, local taxation, public-service claims, and political access before treating revenue as public value.

evidence_debt_register.question: ordinary migrant pathway comparison
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Compare investor processing speed, family inclusion, appeal rights, fees, and public-benefit access against workers, refugees, students, and family migrants.

evidence_debt_register.question: visa-suspension or infringement follow-through
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Monitor whether EU/visa-suspension and court actions actually close scheme perimeter gaps or simply move them into residence/visa products.

policy_pathway: Treat investment migration as a claimant-perimeter and tax-transparency gate, not as ordinary foreign investment.

Require program-level approvals/refusals/revocations, beneficial-owner/source-of-funds failures, physical-presence verification, ordinary-migrant comparison, and visa/infringement follow-through before any comfort score.
